toegepas.blok: 'n Dier hang van sy mense af
toegepas.voor: kan nie vir haar eie kos
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vir' before the object of 'koop' is colloquial; 'self' matches the dog sentence before it and carries the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'vir haar eie kos ... gaan koop' uses colloquial 'vir' before a non-human object and reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kan nie self haar kos ... gaan koop nie' is natural, mirrors the dog sentence before it, and says the same thing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'volmaak' can also be read as 'perfect'; 'volgooi' is the usual verb for filling a water bowl.
toegepas.fout: 'volmaak' after 'skoonmaak' repeats 'maak' and can be misread as the adjective 'perfect'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'volgooi' is the exact, usual verb for filling a water bowl and changes nothing else.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'skoonhou' is a compound verb written as one word, like 'skoonmaak' in the sentence before.
toegepas.fout: 'skoon hou' is written as two words where the word list writes the compound verb 'skoonhou'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plain spelling fix, matching 'skoonmaak' in the sentence before.

toegepas.na: is een van die plekke waar
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'is een plek waar' copies English 'is one place where'; Afrikaans says 'een van die plekke waar'.
toegepas.fout: 'is een plek waar' copies English 'is one place where'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is een van die plekke waar' is the natural Afrikaans and keeps the meaning, which fits the later 'Daar is ook plekke'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'verantwoordelik' takes 'vir', so an infinitive needs the anticipating 'daarvoor'; the bare 'verantwoordelik om' follows English.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'verantwoordelik om ... te sorg' is ordinary Afrikaans, like 'bang om' or 'lus om'; adding 'daarvoor' only makes the sentence heavier for a Grade 6 reader.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit val minder op. Tog ly die dier ook.
laat_vaar.na: Dit val minder op, maar die dier ly tog ook.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Joins two very short sentences into one contrast for better flow; the comma before 'maar' is required because each part has its own subject and verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The two short sentences are a deliberate, emphatic contrast that reads well; joining them is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.blok: As jy sien 'n dier word sleg behandel
na_skrywer.na: om die slegte behandeling te keer
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'dit' directly follows 'die dier' and can be read as stopping or heading off the animal itself; naming what is stopped removes the ambiguity.
na_skrywer.fout: 'om dit te keer' comes straight after 'die dier', so 'dit' can be read as the animal rather than the mistreatment.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a safety instruction (what a child must not do), and 'die slegte behandeling' may drop the neglect the original also covers, so the writer must fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Laat ... in hulle eie plek' is a literal English rendering; 'laat ... met rus' is the Afrikaans idiom for leaving an animal alone and fits the next sentence.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Laat wilde diere ... in hulle eie plek' is a stiff, literal construction.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: It is a safety instruction, and 'met rus' moves the meaning from leaving the animal where it lives to not disturbing it, so the writer owns the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: as jy sien iets is fout met die dier
laat_vaar_vorige.na: as jy sien dat iets met die dier fout is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Spoken main-clause order in a subordinate clause; standard written Afrikaans uses 'dat' with the verb at the end.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'as jy sien iets is fout' is natural spoken Afrikaans for Grade 6, matches the next block's heading 'As jy sien 'n dier word sleg behandel', and sits inside a who-to-tell safety instruction.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: plekke wat seer wilde diere versorg
laat_vaar_vorige.na: plekke wat beseerde wilde diere versorg
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'seer' used attributively before a noun phrase reads unnaturally; 'beseerde' is the normal adjective for injured animals.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'seer diere' is used consistently in the lesson and in the shared veearts definition ('siek en seer diere'), and 'beseerde' narrows it to injury only.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Iemand wie se werk is om
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Iemand wie se werk dit is om
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The construction 'wie se werk dit is om' needs the placeholder 'dit'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'wie se werk is om te gaan kyk' is grammatical as it stands, so this is not a plain grammar error and a shared glossary definition should not be reworded.
